categories.main_business_segments: The company operates three main business segments: (1) Noise reduction (NVH), thermal insulation and lightweight products for vehicle soundproofing, heat insulation and electromagnetic shielding; (2) Electric motors, electric pumps and mechanical pump products for steering, transmission, braking and thermal management systems; (3) Electronic control and automotive electronics products. The company also develops new energy vehicle related products including battery thermal protection and electromagnetic shielding components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in acoustics, thermodynamics, and materials science. Manufacturing methods include multiple molding technologies (injection molding, compression molding, vacuum forming, blow molding, stamping and thermal forming). The company employs advanced production equipment including CNC machine tools and automated assembly lines, combined with flexible manufacturing modes enabling multi-variety batch production. Quality control follows IATF16949:2016 standards with lean six sigma implementation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major global automotive manufacturers including Daimler, BMW, Audi, Volkswagen, Ford, General Motors, Stellantis, Porsche, Renault, Nissan, SAIC, JAC, Great Wall, Geely, and BYD. Products are supplied to both original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and tier-one suppliers. The company also serves industrial machinery sectors. Primary end markets include passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with presence in Asia, Europe, and North America. Major operating locations include China (headquarters in Fuxin, Liaoning; additional facilities in Shenzhen, Changchun, Shanghai, Changzhou), Germany (Leverkusen), United States, Mexico, Japan, and Hong Kong. The company maintains research and development centers in North America, Europe, and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a midstream supplier in the automotive supply chain, positioned as a comprehensive automotive parts system supplier. It supplies components and systems directly to original equipment manufacturers and tier-one suppliers. The company controls core component production and critical manufacturing processes while outsourcing non-critical raw material processing and secondary operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on developing products aligned with automotive industry trends toward intelligence, electrification, integration and lightweight design. Key R&D priorities include: (1) battery thermal protection and electromagnetic shielding for new energy vehicles; (2) electric motors, pumps and electronic controls for electric and hybrid powertrains; (3) thermal management systems for new energy vehicles; (4) hydrogen fuel cell components; (5) solid-state battery technology development. The company emphasizes forward-looking product development and simulation analysis capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of automotive components to original equipment manufacturers and tier-one suppliers. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of products, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company maintains flexible pricing based on customer credit characteristics and market conditions. Revenue streams include sales of noise reduction products (67.74% of 2023 revenue), electric motor and pump products (29.39%), electronic control products (1.82%), and other products (1.05%).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading comprehensive automotive parts system supplier with strong competitive positioning in noise reduction and thermal management products globally. The company competes with international suppliers in core product categories. The company differentiates through advanced R&D capabilities, quality management systems, and established relationships with major global automotive manufacturers. The company holds industry-leading positions in specific product categories while competing in broader automotive parts markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company generated revenue of 4.299 billion yuan in 2023, representing 6.54% growth from 4.035 billion yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 12.88 million yuan in 2023 compared to a loss of 916.30 million yuan in 2022, representing a significant turnaround. Total assets were 4.160 billion yuan at year-end 2023. The company maintains a growth trajectory focused on expanding market share and improving operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) industry-leading acoustic and thermal management solutions with advanced materials and design capabilities; (2) integrated mechatronic products combining mechanical, electrical and hydraulic technologies; (3) comprehensive quality management and testing capabilities including advanced laboratories and testing facilities; (4) global supply network enabling local customer support; (5) strong R&D capabilities with 451 accumulated intellectual property items including 416 patents; (6) established relationships with major global automotive manufacturers providing market access and credibility; (7) focus on new energy vehicle solutions addressing emerging market demands for battery protection and thermal management.
